purpose: Teach: 眉/ポテト/茹で/間取り/スイカ/ありのまま/体型/嫌う

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、眉、結構、整えてるよね、最近、印象、変わったよ、本当に。
lines.en: Hey Riku — you've been keeping up with your eyebrows lately. You look different. Seriously.
lines.style: Teasing but genuine observation. Quick, bright delivery. Slight pause after his name — testing his reaction. Not mean, just direct in the way only a trusted friend can be.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。学食の、ポテト、めっちゃ、好きなんだぜ、俺、毎日、食べてるよ、結構。
lines.en: Yeah. The caf fries are actually incredible. I eat them pretty much every day.
lines.style: Animated, defensive in a light way. Leans into the opinion like it's obvious. Quick breath after 'yeah' — he's already moving to the next thing. Unbothered.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 家庭科で、パスタを、茹でるって、難しいよね、リク、ちょっと、苦戦したよ。
lines.en: Home ec was rough with pasta. You were actually struggling with it too, weren't you?
lines.style: Wry, but not unkind. Observational tone — she noticed something specific about him and it amused her. Slight uptick at the end like she's checking if he remembers.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前の家の間取り、結構、広いって、聞いたぜ、桜、いつか、遊びに行ってもいい?
lines.en: I heard your place is pretty spacious. Could I come over sometime?
lines.style: Curious but careful. Softer than before — this is a real question underneath the casual phrasing. Slight hesitation before 'come over' like he's checking if it's okay to ask. Looking for permission.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 夏祭り、皆で、スイカ割り、しようよ、リク、楽しい思い出に、絶対なるよ。
lines.en: Let's all go to the summer festival together and do watermelon splitting. It'll definitely be a great memory.
lines.style: Eager, inclusive energy. Speaks quickly, painting the picture for him. No doubt in her voice — she's decided this will happen. Warm and inviting, pulling him into the group.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前は、ありのままの自分で、十分、素敵だぜ、桜、無理しないでいいよ、いつも。
lines.en: You're enough just as you are, Sakura. You don't have to try so hard all the time.
lines.style: Soft, direct, serious underneath. Slow pace on the first sentence — he means it. Steady eye contact level. Not sweet, just honest. The kind of thing he's maybe been holding onto for a while.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 体型、気にしてる女子、結構、多いんだよ、リク、わかる?クラスでも、話題なんだ。
lines.en: A lot of girls in our class actually worry about their bodies. You get that, right? It comes up all the time.
lines.style: Reflective, slightly vulnerable. Testing whether he'll understand or judge. Slower pace — she's thinking while she speaks. Seeking validation that this is a real thing, not just her.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 宿題、本当に、嫌う気持ち、あるけど、頑張らないとな、桜、お互いに、頑張ろう。
lines.en: I hate homework, honestly. But we have to push through it. Let's both keep trying.
lines.style: Wry but warm. Self-deprecating about the complaint, then gentler on the encouragement. Extends the effort to him like they're in it together. Close, almost conspiratorial tone.
